assessment.reasoning: Alert HHF-018 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.8 on transaction 3612011 ($34.22). Legacy risk scores are noisy and uncalibrated. In contrast, the bank's calibrated second-generation model scored this transaction at 0.0 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.0063 (0.63%), which is strong evidence of legitimate activity. While the transaction was initiated behind an anonymous proxy, the device D000103 is a generic browser profile (Internet Explorer 11 on desktop) shared by 244 cards before the alert and 51 cards in the recent window, with zero transactions scoring over 0.5 (lift 0.0). Analysis of shared origins shows no clustering of fraud in billing region 299 (lift 0.28). There is no testing sequence or rapid authorization pattern (R5 not met). Historical fraud on card C02753-K1 was confined to card-present out-of-region use months earlier (CC-1739, CC-4010), after which the card was reissued, and the subsequent alert (CC-4570) was cleared. The current holder identity has no confirmed fraud history. Similar model alerts without customer disputes have consistently resolved as cleared legitimate activity. The evidence indicates this alert is a false alarm.
